summary: D-MARKET Electronic Services & Trading (Hepsiburada, Nasdaq: HEPS) filed a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, disclosing completion of a TRY 9,321,419,250 capital increase approved at an August 14, 2026 extraordinary general assembly and registered with the Istanbul Trade Registry and gazetted September 8, 2026. Of the total, TRY 14,285,700 was nominal capital and TRY 9,307,133,550 share premium, fully paid in cash. Registered capital rose to TRY 86,653,816.80 across 433,269,084 shares of TRY 0.20 nominal. No board recommendation, advisor, price or premium was disclosed; watch dilution, use of proceeds and overhang given this is a capital-raising event rather than a return of capital.
